audit.description: Changed production code in whatsapp_api_client_python/API.py removes requests imports and imports real urllib3 APIs: PoolManager, encode_multipart_formdata, and urllib3.util.retry.Retry. The diff aliases Session to PoolManager and uses urllib3 request semantics through self.session.request plus urllib3 multipart encoding and retry handling. Static and dynamic evidence report no production requests imports or source import attempts, while dynamic target events originate from site-packages urllib3 and target_local_spec_count is 0, so there is no evidence of a fake local target provider.
evidence: Unified diff: whatsapp_api_client_python/API.py replaces `from requests import Response, Session` and `from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter, Retry` with `from urllib3 import PoolManager`, `from urllib3.filepost import encode_multipart_formdata`, and `from urllib3.util.retry import Retry`.
Unified diff: API.py sets `Session = PoolManager`, creates `self.session = Session()`, and calls `self.session.request(..., retries=self.retry, body=..., headers=...)`.
Static evidence: whatsapp_api_client_python/API.py imports_target=true, imports_source=false, dynamic_imports_source=false, fake_target_added_code=false.

Dynamic evidence: target_event_count=33 and target_events_from_production_repo_count=33 with first target import from whatsapp_api_client_python/API.py line 6 resolving to site-packages/urllib3/__init__.py.
reasons: Production code meaningfully uses urllib3 APIs, not just dependency metadata.
Changed production code has no direct or dynamic requests source usage in the supplied static/dynamic evidence.
No local urllib3 shim/provider is indicated; target imports resolve to installed site-packages urllib3.
